sourceType: ordinary browser view of public X posts
scope: Initial visible conversation results for three canonical creator posts, plus three selected reply subthreads. Relevant ranking, lazy loading and unavailable replies prevent exhaustive coverage.

observations.summary: The December post presents a physical-column hidden-keys claim and a poll including a ten-BTC option. This does not establish a verified claim or funding.
A reader speculated about a 24-word seed. The one visible follow-up asked whether it worked; no answer or recovery evidence was visible. No candidate was tested.
A contemporaneous reply identifies the El Salvador issue. This corroborates existing article identification, not a new decoding rule or authenticated wallet.
The March announcement visibly links the five previously recovered creator image replies. Image-only continuations add no visible text instruction; the old media analyses remain distinct.
No additional creator-authored extraction instruction or authenticated prize address was recognized in the inspected material. Third-party key-format guesses are not creator clues.

limitations: Not a full account, replies, quote-post or historical archive search.
Displayed reply counters do not prove all replies were accessible or reviewed.
No raw third-party secret-looking values, seed phrases, profile contact details or signed-in account UI are redistributed.
Normal browser reading only; no authentication changes, challenge handling, outreach, posts or reactions.
